McLaren: McLaren has given the car a subtle facelift – the side‑pod intakes and engine cover have been reshaped, the rear‑suspension fairings re‑profiled and the rear‑wing flap set to a lower‑drag position, while a new floor‑edge, diffuser and circuit‑specific cooling‑louvre layout tighten up the aerodynamics and keep the power unit cool. All of these tweaks are aimed at squeezing a little extra grip into the corners and shaving precious seconds off the straight‑line runs, exactly the kind of edge drivers need on a tight, high‑speed weekend. In short, the car should feel more stable through the bends and faster on the straights, giving McLaren a better shot at fighting the front pack.
